title: Somsack SENGMANY (newborn)
description: The subject of every journey: a Lao baby boy born 2025-10-28 at Chiang Rai Provincial Hospital, Thailand (Country A), while his family lives in Lao PDR (Country B). Has no Thai identity number; registered in Lao PDR with a temporary id by the CHW (J2). Holds no device and acts through his parents. The story is the VaxLink workshop walkthrough's (fredhersch/vaxlink). Fictional.

persona.name: Somsack
persona.goal: Get every vaccine he needs, once, wherever he is.
needs: His birth doses to count at home
His history to be there when a doctor needs it
frustrations: Born where he has no national ID
Invisible to the home system until someone registers him
